# AgriSenseAI Functional Documentation

## Purpose
This document describes how the current project works, how data is displayed, the app navigation flow, Firebase configuration, and the planned sensor connectivity flow (Bluetooth and Wi-Fi). It is based on the current codebase and highlights what is implemented vs. planned.

## App Flow (Implemented)
- Router and auth redirects are defined in [lib/core/router/app_router.dart](lib/core/router/app_router.dart).
- Initial boot starts at Splash in [lib/core/router/route_names.dart](lib/core/router/route_names.dart).
- App entry initializes Firebase, DI, and responsive config in [lib/main.dart](lib/main.dart).

Mermaid flow (use this in a PDF export):

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[Splash Screen] --> B{Auth Session Ready}
  B -->|Authenticated| C[Home]
  B -->|Not Authenticated| D{Onboarding Completed}
  D -->|No| E[Onboarding]
  D -->|Yes| F[Auth]
  E --> F
  F --> C
```

Notes:
- Splash navigation decisions are in [lib/features/splash_onboarding/presentation/screens/splash_screen.dart](lib/features/splash_onboarding/presentation/screens/splash_screen.dart).
- Onboarding completion is stored using secure storage in [lib/core/services/local_storage/local_storage_service.dart](lib/core/services/local_storage/local_storage_service.dart).

## Home Flow (After Login)
Mermaid flow for the Home experience and its data path:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
   A[Home Screen] --> B[Home Provider loadDashboard]
   B --> C[Home Repository]
   C --> D[Home Local Data Source]
   D --> E[Home Dashboard Model]
   E --> F[Home Widgets Render]
   F --> G[Sensor Cards]
   F --> H[Smart Action Card]
   F --> I[Water Logs Sheet]
   F --> J[Pump Control Sheet]
   J --> K{Pump On?}
   K -->|Yes| L[Pump Button Highlight]
   K -->|No| M[Pump Button Normal]
```

References:
- Home screen + provider: [lib/features/home/presentation/screens/home_screen.dart](lib/features/home/presentation/screens/home_screen.dart)
- Data source: [lib/features/home/data/datasources/home_local_datasource.dart](lib/features/home/data/datasources/home_local_datasource.dart)
- Widgets: [lib/features/home/presentation/widgets/home_dashboard_widgets.dart](lib/features/home/presentation/widgets/home_dashboard_widgets.dart)

## How Sensor Data Is Shown (Current Implementation)
- Sensor cards are rendered in [lib/features/home/presentation/widgets/home_dashboard_widgets.dart](lib/features/home/presentation/widgets/home_dashboard_widgets.dart).
- Data displayed on the home dashboard comes from a local mock data source in [lib/features/home/data/datasources/home_local_datasource.dart](lib/features/home/data/datasources/home_local_datasource.dart).

# AgriSenseAI Functional Documentation

## Purpose
This document describes how the current project works, how data is displayed, the app navigation flow, Firebase configuration, and the planned sensor connectivity flow (Bluetooth and Wi-Fi). It is based on the current codebase and highlights what is implemented vs. planned.

## App Flow (Implemented)
- Router and auth redirects are defined in [lib/core/router/app_router.dart](lib/core/router/app_router.dart).
- Initial boot starts at Splash in [lib/core/router/route_names.dart](lib/core/router/route_names.dart).
- App entry initializes Firebase, DI, and responsive config in [lib/main.dart](lib/main.dart).

Mermaid flow (use this in a PDF export):

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[Splash Screen] --> B{Auth Session Ready}
  B -->|Authenticated| C[Home]
  B -->|Not Authenticated| D{Onboarding Completed}
  D -->|No| E[Onboarding]
  D -->|Yes| F[Auth]
  E --> F
  F --> C
```

Notes:
- Splash navigation decisions are in [lib/features/splash_onboarding/presentation/screens/splash_screen.dart](lib/features/splash_onboarding/presentation/screens/splash_screen.dart).
- Onboarding completion is stored using secure storage in [lib/core/services/local_storage/local_storage_service.dart](lib/core/services/local_storage/local_storage_service.dart).

## Home Flow (After Login)
Mermaid flow for the Home experience and its data path:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
   A[Home Screen] --> B[Home Provider loadDashboard]
   B --> C[Home Repository]
   C --> D[Home Local Data Source]
   D --> E[Home Dashboard Model]
   E --> F[Home Widgets Render]
   F --> G[Sensor Cards]
   F --> H[Smart Action Card]
   F --> I[Water Logs Sheet]
   F --> J[Pump Control Sheet]
   J --> K{Pump On?}
   K -->|Yes| L[Pump Button Highlight]
   K -->|No| M[Pump Button Normal]
```

References:
- Home screen + provider: [lib/features/home/presentation/screens/home_screen.dart](lib/features/home/presentation/screens/home_screen.dart)
- Data source: [lib/features/home/data/datasources/home_local_datasource.dart](lib/features/home/data/datasources/home_local_datasource.dart)
- Widgets: [lib/features/home/presentation/widgets/home_dashboard_widgets.dart](lib/features/home/presentation/widgets/home_dashboard_widgets.dart)

## Full App Sitemap (All Screens)
Mermaid sitemap of all user-facing screens and tabs:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
   A[Splash] --> B[Onboarding]
   A --> C[Auth]
   B --> C
   C --> D[Navbar (Main App)]
   D --> D1[Home]
   D --> D2[Alerts]
   D --> D3[Analytics]
   D --> D4[Devices]
   D --> D5[Settings]
   D1 --> E[Profile]
```

References:
- Router setup: [lib/core/router/app_router.dart](lib/core/router/app_router.dart)
- Bottom navigation tabs: [lib/features/navbar/presentation/screens/navbar_screen.dart](lib/features/navbar/presentation/screens/navbar_screen.dart)
- Profile entry: [lib/features/home/presentation/widgets/home_header_widgets.dart](lib/features/home/presentation/widgets/home_header_widgets.dart)

## Devices Flow (Bluetooth/Wi-Fi Pairing + Connection States)
Current flow uses mock data and UI states:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
   A[Devices Screen] --> B[Devices Provider loadDevices]
   B --> C[Devices Repository]
   C --> D[Devices Local Data Source]
   D --> E[Devices Dashboard Model]
   E --> F[Paired Devices List]
   E --> G[Available Devices List]
   F --> H[Device Action Sheet]
   G --> I[Connect Button]
   I --> J[Planned: Bluetooth/Wi-Fi Pairing]
```

References:
- Devices screen: [lib/features/devices/presentation/screens/devices_screen.dart](lib/features/devices/presentation/screens/devices_screen.dart)
- Provider: [lib/features/devices/presentation/providers/devices_provider.dart](lib/features/devices/presentation/providers/devices_provider.dart)
- Mock data: [lib/features/devices/data/datasources/devices_local_datasource.dart](lib/features/devices/data/datasources/devices_local_datasource.dart)
- UI cards: [lib/features/devices/presentation/widgets/paired_device_card.dart](lib/features/devices/presentation/widgets/paired_device_card.dart)
- Action sheet: [lib/features/devices/presentation/widgets/device_action_sheet.dart](lib/features/devices/presentation/widgets/device_action_sheet.dart)

## Alerts + Notifications Flow
Alerts are rendered from local data; notifications are initialized with local handlers and a background FCM handler.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
   A[Alerts Screen] --> B[Alerts Provider loadAlerts]
   B --> C[Alerts Repository]
   C --> D[Alerts Local Data Source]
   D --> E[Alert Sections]
   E --> F[Alert Cards Rendered]
   N[FCM Message] --> O[Background Handler]
   O --> P[Local Notification Display]
   Q[Local Tap] --> R[App Handles Payload]
```

References:
- Alerts screen: [lib/features/alerts/presentation/screens/alerts_screen.dart](lib/features/alerts/presentation/screens/alerts_screen.dart)
- Provider: [lib/features/alerts/presentation/providers/alerts_provider.dart](lib/features/alerts/presentation/providers/alerts_provider.dart)
- Mock data: [lib/features/alerts/data/datasources/alerts_local_datasource.dart](lib/features/alerts/data/datasources/alerts_local_datasource.dart)
- Local notifications: [lib/core/services/notifications/notification_local_handler.dart](lib/core/services/notifications/notification_local_handler.dart)
- Background handler: [lib/core/services/notifications/notification_background_handler.dart](lib/core/services/notifications/notification_background_handler.dart)

## Analytics Flow (Data Source to Charts)
Analytics dashboards are built from local mock data and rendered per time range.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
   A[Analytics Screen] --> B[Analytics Provider loadDashboard]
   B --> C[Analytics Repository]
   C --> D[Analytics Local Data Source]
   D --> E[Analytics Dashboard Model]
   E --> F[Day/Week/Month Screen]
   F --> G[Metric Charts + Averages]
```

References:
- Analytics screen: [lib/features/analytics/presentation/screens/analytics_screen.dart](lib/features/analytics/presentation/screens/analytics_screen.dart)
- Provider: [lib/features/analytics/presentation/providers/analytics_provider.dart](lib/features/analytics/presentation/providers/analytics_provider.dart)
- Mock data: [lib/features/analytics/data/datasources/analytics_local_datasource.dart](lib/features/analytics/data/datasources/analytics_local_datasource.dart)

## Settings/Profile Flow
Settings and Profile are separate screens loaded from their own providers and repositories.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
   A[Settings Screen] --> B[Settings Provider loadSettings]
   B --> C[Settings Repository]
   C --> D[Settings Dashboard Model]
   D --> E[Preferences + Thresholds + Profile Settings]
   F[Profile Screen] --> G[Profile Provider loadProfile]
   G --> H[Profile Repository]
   H --> I[Profile Dashboard Model]
   I --> J[Profile Summary + Logout]
```

References:
- Settings screen: [lib/features/settings/presentation/screens/settings_screen.dart](lib/features/settings/presentation/screens/settings_screen.dart)
- Settings provider: [lib/features/settings/presentation/providers/settings_provider.dart](lib/features/settings/presentation/providers/settings_provider.dart)
- Profile screen: [lib/features/profile/presentation/screens/profile_screen.dart](lib/features/profile/presentation/screens/profile_screen.dart)
- Profile provider: [lib/features/profile/presentation/providers/profile_provider.dart](lib/features/profile/presentation/providers/profile_provider.dart)

## How Sensor Data Is Shown (Current Implementation)
- Sensor cards are rendered in [lib/features/home/presentation/widgets/home_dashboard_widgets.dart](lib/features/home/presentation/widgets/home_dashboard_widgets.dart).
- Data displayed on the home dashboard comes from a local mock data source in [lib/features/home/data/datasources/home_local_datasource.dart](lib/features/home/data/datasources/home_local_datasource.dart).
- Sensor models and entities are defined in [lib/features/home/data/models/sensor_reading_model.dart](lib/features/home/data/models/sensor_reading_model.dart) and [lib/features/home/domain/entities/sensor_reading.dart](lib/features/home/domain/entities/sensor_reading.dart).

Current flow for data display:
1. Home screen calls `loadDashboard()` in [lib/features/home/presentation/providers/home_provider.dart](lib/features/home/presentation/providers/home_provider.dart).
2. Provider fetches mock dashboard data from [lib/features/home/data/datasources/home_local_datasource.dart](lib/features/home/data/datasources/home_local_datasource.dart).
3. UI renders `HomeSensorCard` widgets for each `SensorReading` in [lib/features/home/presentation/widgets/home_dashboard_widgets.dart](lib/features/home/presentation/widgets/home_dashboard_widgets.dart).

## Sensor Connectivity (Bluetooth and Wi-Fi)
### Current status
- There is no production Bluetooth/Wi-Fi connection service in the codebase yet.
- The Devices feature is currently driven by mock data in [lib/features/devices/data/datasources/devices_local_datasource.dart](lib/features/devices/data/datasources/devices_local_datasource.dart).

### Proposed implementation plan (to make connectivity functional)
This section is a plan, not yet implemented.

1. **Bluetooth discovery and pairing**
   - Create a core service (e.g., `core/services/bluetooth/bluetooth_service.dart`) that wraps a Bluetooth package.
   - Expose: `scan()`, `connect(deviceId)`, `disconnect()`, and `streamConnectionState()`.
   - Store paired devices locally (secure storage or a small local DB).

2. **Wi-Fi provisioning**
   - Create a core service (e.g., `core/services/wifi/wifi_provisioning_service.dart`).
   - Implement device provisioning flow: connect to device AP, send Wi-Fi SSID/password, then verify device online.

3. **Sensor data ingestion**
   - Add a data source that reads device data either from:
     - Bluetooth GATT characteristics, or
     - Wi-Fi (HTTP or MQTT) to a device gateway.
   - Map raw data into `SensorReading` models.

4. **Repository layer wiring**
   - Add a device repository for fetching live sensor data.
   - Swap home dashboard local datasource for real data source once stable.

5. **UI updates**
   - Update devices list to display real connection state.
   - Update home dashboard to show live sensor stream and last update times.

## Firebase Setup (Implemented + Required Steps)
### Implemented in code
- Firebase options are generated in [lib/firebase_options.dart](lib/firebase_options.dart).
- Firebase initialization is in [lib/main.dart](lib/main.dart).
- Project metadata is stored in [firebase.json](firebase.json).

### Required setup steps (Firebase Console)
1. Create a Firebase project (already set to `agrisenseai-app`).
2. Add Android and iOS apps:
   - Android application id and config are referenced in [firebase.json](firebase.json).
   - Download `google-services.json` and place it at [android/app/google-services.json](android/app/google-services.json).
   - For iOS, add `GoogleService-Info.plist` to the iOS Runner target.
3. Enable Authentication:
   - Enable Google provider if using Google Sign-In.
4. Configure Cloud Messaging (Notifications):
   - Ensure FCM is enabled.
   - Verify notification channels in [lib/core/services/notifications/notification_local_handler.dart](lib/core/services/notifications/notification_local_handler.dart).
   - Background handler is defined in [lib/core/services/notifications/notification_background_handler.dart](lib/core/services/notifications/notification_background_handler.dart).

Note: `NotificationService` is currently a placeholder in [lib/core/services/notifications/notification_service.dart](lib/core/services/notifications/notification_service.dart).

## Theme Reference (Use in PDF)
Theme tokens are defined in [lib/core/theme](lib/core/theme):
- Colors: [lib/core/theme/app_colors.dart](lib/core/theme/app_colors.dart)
- Typography: [lib/core/theme/app_text_style.dart](lib/core/theme/app_text_style.dart)
- Fonts: [lib/core/theme/app_fonts.dart](lib/core/theme/app_fonts.dart)
- Spacing: [lib/core/theme/app_spacing.dart](lib/core/theme/app_spacing.dart)
- Border Radius: [lib/core/theme/app_border_radius.dart](lib/core/theme/app_border_radius.dart)

Recommended summary block for the PDF:
- Primary color: `#2E7D32`
- Accent blue: `#4FC3F7`
- Accent yellow: `#FBC02D`
- Background: `#F5F7F4`
- Surface: `#FFFFFF`
- Font family: Poppins (Regular/Medium/SemiBold)
- Rounded corners: 16px buttons, 24px cards

## Next Steps to Fully Functional Hardware Integration
- Implement Bluetooth and Wi-Fi services in core.
- Add repository + datasource for live sensor data.
- Replace home local datasource with live datasource.
- Add device provisioning UI and error states.

---
If you want, I can expand this into a full PDF-ready document with diagrams for devices, auth, and data pipelines once the connectivity services are implemented.
